notes.general_comments:
This paper was taken by 1195 candidates. The mean score was 16.75 with a standard deviation of 5.5.
The intended facility of the items was 0.25 to 0.80. Two items proved to be too easy. These were items 21
and 28. However items 17 and 22 proved to be too difficult.
There was one item, 22, where discrimination was below the design limit of 0.25.
There were no specific areas of weakness in candidates’ understanding.
